mapper.insert: insert into users (id, username, email, password, bio, image, created_at, updated_at) values (#{user.id}, #{user.username}, #{user.email}, #{user.password}, #{user.bio}, #{user.image}, #{user.createdAt}, #{user.updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, username, email, password, bio, image, created_at, updated_at from users where username = #{username}
select id, username, email, password, bio, image, created_at, updated_at from users where email = #{email}
select id, username, email, password, bio, image, created_at, updated_at from users where id = #{id}
